products.name: WhyLabs
products.note: Data-centric AI observability; statistical profiling; privacy-preserving monitoring

profile_text.body:
WhyLabs, Inc. was an AI observability company that described itself as a pioneer in defining the AI observability category, offering a platform focused on data-centric monitoring, statistical profiling, and privacy-preserving oversight of AI systems. The company has since discontinued operations, announcing on its website that it is closing after what it characterizes as an incredible journey building responsible AI operations tools alongside customers and a broader community.

Although the company itself is winding down, it notes that its open-source contributions will persist. Chief among these is whylogs, described as an open standard for data logging that enables privacy-preserving logging and monitoring for AI systems. WhyLabs also points to the Robust and Responsible AI community, which it says engaged thousands of participants, as a legacy it hopes will continue spreading best practices across the industry.

The site's held facts record WhyLabs under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, with its core product noted for data-centric AI observability, statistical profiling, and privacy-preserving monitoring. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available data.
